label: Bryndza podhalańska
note: Polish PDO: at most 40% cow milk

about.text: Bryndza Podhalańska is a Polish PDO cheese from the Podhale region, made from sheep milk with at most 40% cow milk.

facts.v: Polish Mountain sheep; cow's milk (Polish Red) at most 40 % of the total
